verdict.rationale: Box AI API lets users ask questions, extract metadata, and summarize files in natural language (box-docs-9, box-docs-33), and Box Hubs let users 'get answers with Box AI' (box-docs-13), showing some natural-language interaction with content. However, evidence does not show broader natural-language command operation of the product itself (e.g., uploading, sharing, organizing, or managing collaborations via NL) — those remain API/SDK driven. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands controlling core Box actions (uploads, sharing, permissions) rather than just Q&A/summarization, and independent hands-on confirmation of this NL interface working well.
